headline: Illa Reaches the Midpoint of His Term with First Budget Already Approved, Facing Crises in Rodalies and Education
summary: Catalan president Salvador Illa has reached the midpoint of his term with his first budget already approved. The Govern faces crises in Rodalies rail services and education, and plans to focus on housing.
why: Catalonia is one of Spain's largest regional economies, and its budget shapes public spending on infrastructure, housing and services.
